M-RESOLUTION.Purpose: Resolve child-owned literal `parents` selectors by nearest-upward filesystem lookup, and infer the finite graph-discovery boundary for `graph` anchors.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Selector compilation and literal upward lookup through filesystem root.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Graph boundary inference from a file/directory anchor.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Repository-wide search, glob expansion, project/workspace root concepts.

Requirements.REQ-001: Selector form: `@` + literal relative path; `@` is mandatory.
Requirements.REQ-002: Lookup: declaring-file directory -> ancestor directories -> filesystem root; the first candidate base where the literal target is a valid canonical regular file wins.
Requirements.REQ-003: A literal selector resolves to exactly one canonical target or a diagnostic; a missing candidate at one level continues upward; no valid target through filesystem root is a diagnostic.
Requirements.REQ-004: Glob/wildcard/brace/class/escape selector syntax is unsupported and diagnosed; absolute paths and `..` are forbidden.
Requirements.REQ-005: `.git`, symlinks, and generated/derived paths are excluded target space; symlink traversal and canonical symlink targets are forbidden.
Requirements.REQ-006: Resolution has no dependency on `.frostline`, `.git`, `HOME`, `cwd`, workspace, project, graph cache, or full scan; `cwd` is permitted only as lexical base for a relative CLI path.
Requirements.REQ-007: Graph boundary inference: 1) explicit `--root` when supplied and containing the anchor; 2) nearest ancestor directory containing `.frostline/`; 3) nearest containing a Git root; 4) top-level child directory of `HOME` containing the anchor.

Inputs.IN-001: Selector raw text and declaring-file directory.
Inputs.IN-002: Graph anchor path and optional explicit root.

Outputs.OUT-002: `graphBoundary`: one finite scan root or a requirement for explicit root.
